name: Enabling-Skill-
title_zh: 九件套工具包，按需取用不占位
tagline_zh: 别人给你一抽屉工具，这个货架只放九件精品。每件独立启停，不互相拖累。适合想给 Agent 配齐常用能力。
tagline_en: Others hand you a drawer of tools; this shelf holds nine sharp ones. Each starts and stops alone, no baggage. For.
why_zh: 九个技能彼此独立，按需装载，不互相污染上下文。缺哪个补哪个，装多了也不怕——每个都轻，合起来才重。
why_en: Nine independent skills, loaded on demand, no context bleed. Add only what you lack; each is light, weight only when combined.
limit_zh: 这是合集不是单个技能，装完得自己挑着用。九个技能各自有适用边界，超出范围不会自动降级，得手动换别的。
limit_en: A pack, not one skill—you must pick which to enable. Each has its own scope; no graceful fallback outside it. No bundled docs; novices may not know.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 9-skill toolkit, load only what you need
